text:
marta: quick sync — we need to align on keystore onboarding acceptance for the field evals customers asked for. short bullets please

sam: can you list the specific asks from the pilot customers?

marta: sure — two customers want: 1) BYOK handshake w/ TTL for tenant keys, 2) exportable evidence bundle for audits, 3) retention toggles per-tenant (30/90/365d).

leo: security note: TTL for tenant keys implies rotation/renewal flow + escrow. need spec for what 'TTL' means (soft expiry vs forced rotate).

ashley: from CS: customers expect a one-click onboarding flow and a verification test that proves keys are correctly used (sample signing or encryption roundtrip).

sam: ok — technical constraints: runtime currently supports keystore handshake + vault plugins. missing pieces: evidence export schema, tenant-retention flag in API, and an onboarding verification endpoint.

marta: proposed minimal acceptance criteria (MVP):
- BYOK handshake completes and is recorded in audit log with key metadata (key-id, alg, creation_ts)
- onboarding test endpoint returns 200 + signed nonce using tenant key
- evidence export returns zipped artifacts with manifest + signature (max 1GB)
- retention flag available in tenant API, with server-enforced deletion scheduled

leo: add SOC2 mapping: the audit record must include user/service actor, action, object id, and outcome. store hashes of exported evidence for integrity.

ashley: also need UX acceptance: wizard copy, success/errors surfaced, and a fallback if KMS is unreachable (explain SLA).

marta: rollout policy: canary to 5 pilot tenants, then 25, then GA. canaries must exercise key rotate and evidence export.

sam: engineering checklist:
1) API: POST /v1/tenants/:id/keystore/handshake (payload below)
2) New audit fields in event store
3) export job + signed manifest generator
4) retention cron + soft-delete lake

sam: code snippet for handshake payload:
```json
{
  "key_uri": "kms://projects/p/locations/l/keyRings/r/cryptoKeys/k/cryptoKeyVersions/1",
  "public_key_pem": "-----BEGIN PUBLIC KEY-----...",
  "ttl_days": 365,
  "customer_contact": "sec@customer.com"
}
```

leo: looks good. we need threat cases: compromised key (revoke + re-export evidence), mismatched algs, and stale TTL where customer rotated outside handshake. Add playbook.

marta: legal-bot — can you confirm retention durations (30/90/365) are acceptable from a contract standpoint? and any notes on export encryption standards? @legal-bot

legal-bot: retention buckets ok for standard enterprise customers. export must be encrypted in transit (TLS 1.2+) and at rest (AES-256). include customer certificate fingerprint in manifest.

ashley: ops question: how long does evidence export take for 1M events? need perf target for SLA.

sam: estimate: export stream + gzipped manifest ~ 10-20 mins for 1M rows on current infra; will add progress/webhook for long jobs.

marta: final ask: owners and due dates for MVP scope? Sam (eng) - API + export generator - due EOW + 3w for tests; Leo (security) - threat model & playbook - due EOW; Ashley (CS) - pilot comms & UX - due next Tue. I'll consolidate and share PRD.

ashley: noted. i'll schedule pilot kickoff with the two customers next Wed. :calendar:

sam: I'll open a tracking ticket and link here when created.

marta: thanks all — will follow up with PRD and acceptance checklist. :thumbsup:
